paragraphs: Mia came to Lily's house on Sunday afternoon. She had a small plastic box in her hands. The box was half full of green leaves. "This is our jungle for the school project," said Mia. "Look inside." Lily looked and saw a big black beetle. It walked slowly on a leaf. Mia found it in her garden. She wanted to look after it for one afternoon. Lily liked the idea.

The girls put the box on the floor. Pip was asleep on a red cushion next to the sofa. He liked that cushion very much. Lily went to the kitchen for paper and pencils. Mia stayed with the box. She opened the lid to give the beetle a new leaf. The beetle climbed out of the box. It went to the cushion and climbed up on Pip's brown fur. Mia was very surprised. "Lily," she said quietly, "come here."

Lily came back and stopped at the door. Pip was still asleep. The room was very quiet. The beetle sat on his fur and did not move. Mia looked at Lily, and Lily looked at Mia. What do you think happens next? Does Pip wake up? Does the beetle fly away? Guess before you read the next part.

The beetle walked slowly up Pip's back. Pip moved one ear, but he did not wake up. Mia held out her hand carefully. The beetle walked on her finger. Lily held the box close, and Mia put the beetle in it. "Now the jungle is safe," said Mia. Pip slept for another half hour. He never knew about the beetle.
